title: Deep Integration of Gemini and Full Series Upgrades: Google Officially Launches the New Pixel 11 Smartphone Series

content_html:
Recently, the tech giant Google officially launched its highly anticipated Pixel 11 smartphone series. Compared to previous generations, the new model has relatively limited changes in appearance design and core hardware. Its real core highlights are focused on the software experience and deep integration with Gemini AI. By offering more autonomous agent-like features, it helps users efficiently complete various daily tasks in the background.

In terms of AI experience, Gemini on the Pixel 11 demonstrates stronger autonomous agent execution capabilities. For specific markets, it not only assists users in ordering groceries, booking ride-hailing services, or buying coffee, but can also make calls on behalf of users to book restaurant tables or clinic appointments. Users can take over or terminate tasks at any time during the process and view the call logs at any time. Meanwhile, several previous practical features have been fully upgraded, allowing them to retrieve contextual information across apps and actively recommend restaurants or performances to users. The previously released voice transcription tool "Rambler" has also been officially integrated into the new device.

In terms of daily utility and imaging systems, the Pixel 11 supports real-time translation of video, podcasts, and voice messages into target languages; the original "word search" gesture can now be directly used in the camera interface; the camera also adds an accessibility feature that uses Gemini to translate sign language into text in real time. In terms of imaging, the new model introduces an AI photography feature called "Magic Capture," allowing users to select the best moment from hundreds of automatically captured images between starting and ending the recording, thus capturing high-quality photos while filming videos. Additionally, the Pixel 11 Pro series has increased its super zoom capability to 120x, while the base model has increased to 30x. The Pro models also introduce an "Instant Night Sight" night mode, significantly reducing capture time and supporting 8K video enhancement.

In terms of hardware and performance configuration, the Pixel 11 series is equipped with a new Tensor G6 processor, which not only improves energy efficiency but also increases web browsing speed by 25% and reduces the latency of running the latest AI models. The base storage capacity of the entire series has been upgraded to 256GB. The starting price for the Pixel 11 is $899, the Pixel 11 Pro starts at $1,099, and the top-of-the-line Pixel 11 Pro XL starts at $1,299.

content_html_zh:
近日，科技巨头谷歌正式推出了备受期待的Pixel 11智能手机系列。 与前几代相比，新机型在外观设计和核心硬件方面变化相对有限。 其真正核心亮点在于软件体验以及与Gemini AI的深度融合。 通过提供更多类似自主代理的功能，帮助用户在后台高效完成各种日常任务。

在AI体验方面，Pixel 11上的Gemini展现出了更强的自主代理执行能力。 针对特定市场，它不仅可以帮助用户订购杂货、预订叫车服务或购买咖啡，还可以代表用户拨打电话预订餐厅餐桌或诊所预约。 用户可以在过程中随时接管或终止任务，并随时查看通话记录。 同时，之前的几个实用功能也得到了全面升级，可以跨应用检索上下文信息，并向用户主动推荐餐厅或表演。 此前发布的语音转录工具“Rambler”也已正式集成到新设备中。

在日常实用和影像系统方面，Pixel 11支持将视频、播客和语音消息实时翻译成目标语言；原来的“查词”手势现在可以直接在相机界面使用；该相机还添加了辅助功能，使用 Gemini 将手语实时翻译为文本。 成像方面，新机型引入了名为“魔拍”的AI摄影功能，允许用户在开始和结束录制之间从数百张自动拍摄的图像中选择最佳时刻，从而在拍摄视频的同时捕捉到高质量的照片。 此外，Pixel 11 Pro系列将超级变焦能力提升至120倍，基础型号则提升至30倍。 Pro型号还引入了“即时夜视”夜间模式，显着缩短拍摄时间并支持8K视频增强。

在硬件和性能配置方面，Pixel 11系列搭载了全新的Tensor G6处理器，不仅提高了能效，还将网页浏览速度提升了25%，并降低了运行最新AI模型的延迟。 全系列基础存储容量升级至256GB。 Pixel 11 起售价为 899 美元，Pixel 11 Pro 起售价为 1,099 美元，顶级 Pixel 11 Pro XL 起售价为 1,299 美元。
